title: NFL legend Calvin Johnson wants Chiefs to trade for this superstar WR
text:
NFL legend reveals which superstar WR KC Chiefs should trade for Schedule NFL News Draft Fantasy Odds Betting Newsletter CHIEFS NFL legend Calvin Johnson wants Chiefs to trade for this superstar WR
 John Dillon Chiefs Wire Oct. 26, 2026, 3:17 p.m. CT During an October 26 appearance on 'Up and Adams,' NFL legend Calvin Johnson revealed that he wants the Kansas City Chiefs to trade for New York Jets wide receiver Garrett Wilson.
 A former first-round pick and 2022 NFL Rookie of the Year, Wilson is widely considered to be one of the most dynamic pass-catchers in the league and will be a hot commodity if New York decides to make him available before the November 10 trade deadline.
 Kansas City has a serious need at the wide receiver position after veterans Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton sustained injuries during the Chiefs' Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.
 While general manager Brett Veach would have to get creative to make Wilson's massive contract jive with Kansas City's limited salary cap space, the Chiefs would undoubtedly benefit from the Jets superstar's presence in Andy Reid's struggling offense, which only managed to score three points in a Week 7 loss to the Seattle Seahawks on 'Sunday Night Football.'
